get.description:
Confirm a credential and read remaining quota.

Uses ``peek``, not ``hit``: checking your own quota must not consume it.

The published catalog. Authenticated — unlike ``GET /api/skills/``, this does
not expose the full chat-skill registry, and there is no reason to let anonymous
callers enumerate even the published builder tools.

Not charged against either bucket, and so carries no ``X-RateLimit-*`` headers:
the catalog costs nothing upstream, and a client re-reading it should not spend
its call budget on discovery. Read quota from ``/whoami`` or from a tool call.

post.description:
REST equivalent of ``tools/call``.

Unlike JSON-RPC, a failing tool here surfaces as HTTP 400 with an
``ErrorEnvelope`` — REST clients expect status codes to carry failure, and the
trace_id lands in the body either way.

post.description:
Single JSON-RPC endpoint: ``initialize``, ``tools/list``, ``tools/call``.

Parsed by hand rather than via a FastAPI body model because a malformed body
must produce a JSON-RPC error object, not FastAPI's 422 — an MCP client cannot
read the latter. Notifications (no ``id``) get 202 with no body, as the spec
requires.
